'''Alexander Yuryevich Rumyantsev''' ({{langx|ru|Александр Юрьевич Румянцев}}; born July 26, 1945) is a Russian scientist, [[academician]], minister, and ambassador.
== Career ==

Since graduating [[Moscow Engineering Physics Institute (National Research Nuclear University)|MEPhI]] 1969, worked in [[Kurchatov Institute]] researching [[nuclear physics]]. In 1994, he was appointed as the director of the [[Kurchatov Institute]]. In 1996 he was elected as the corresponding member of the [[Russian Academy of Sciences]], and since 2000 is the [[academician]].

[[File:Vladimir Putin 16 May 2001-3.jpg|thumb|250px|Alexander Rumjantsev with president [[Vladimir Putin|Putinin]] in 2001]]

In 2001 he was appointed as the Minister of the Atomic Energy of the Russian Federation, in the [[Mikhail Kasyanov's Cabinet|cabinet]] of the Prime Minister [[Mikhail Kasyanov]]. During his tenure the [[Megatons to Megawatts]] agreement was renegotiated in 2002.<ref>[https://www.nytimes.com/2014/01/28/science/thomas-l-neffs-idea-turned-russian-warheads-into-american-electricity.html From Warheads to Cheap Energy], [[William Broad|William J. Broad]], [[The New York Times|NYT]] 27 January 2014</ref><ref>[http://www.usec.com/russian-contracts/megatons-megawatts USEC website] {{webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20140113070126/http://www.usec.com/russian-contracts/megatons-megawatts |date=2014-01-13 }}</ref> Following the dismissal of the whole cabinet in February 2004 by [[Vladimir Putin|President Putin]], the Ministry was reorganized into a [[Rosatom|Federal Agency on Atomic Energy]] where Alexander Rumyantsev was appointed as the CEO.<ref>{{Cite web |url=http://www.rosatom.ru/wps/wcm/connect/rosatom/rosatomsite.eng/about/nuclear_industry/history/ |title=History of Russian Nuclear Industry |access-date=2012-01-28 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20120601184345/http://www.rosatom.ru/wps/wcm/connect/rosatom/rosatomsite.eng/about/nuclear_industry/history/ |archive-date=2012-06-01 |url-status=dead }}</ref> He stepped down from this post in November 2005 during the international scandal<ref>[http://www.swissinfo.ch/eng/Home/Archive/Russia_demands_extradition_of_arrested_minister.html?cid=4514542 Russia demands extradition of arrested minister], [[swissinfo]], 19 May 2005</ref> involving his predecessor as a Minister, [[Yevgeny Adamov]].

In preparation for his next job Alexander Rumyantsev graduated the Higher Diplomatic Courses of the [[Diplomatic Academy of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs of the Russian Federation|Diplomatic Academy of the Russian MFA]] in 2006, and was posted as the [[List of ambassadors of Russia to Finland|Russian ambassador to the Republic of Finland]].<ref>{{Cite web |url=http://document.kremlin.ru/doc.asp?ID=033382 |title=Указ Президента РФ от 21.04.2006 N 418 |access-date=2012-01-28 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20061011203454/http://document.kremlin.ru/doc.asp?ID=033382 |archive-date=2006-10-11 |url-status=dead }}</ref> Later he was awarded the [[diplomatic rank]] of the Ambassador Extraordinary and Plenipotentiary of the Russian Federation in April 2008.<ref>{{Deprecated archive|url=https://archive.today/20120708052934/http://document.kremlin.ru/doc.asp?ID=045414|title=Указ Президента РФ от 23.04.2008 N 549}}</ref>

== Awards and decorations ==
* 1986 - [[USSR State Prize]] for the cycle of works on "New methods of research in the field of [[solid-state physics]] based on [[Neutron scattering|scattering the neutrons]] in stationary [[nuclear reactor]]s"{{cite quote|date=September 2022}}
* 2001 - [[Order of Honour (Russian Federation)|Order of Honour]]<ref>{{Cite web |url=http://graph.document.kremlin.ru/page.aspx?1;689661 |title=Указ Президента Российской Федерации от 26 июля 2001 года № 922 |access-date=2012-01-28 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20150402155727/http://graph.document.kremlin.ru/page.aspx?1;689661 |archive-date=2015-04-02 |url-status=dead }}</ref>
* 2005 - [[Order of Merit for the Fatherland]] IV class<ref>{{Cite web |url=http://graph.document.kremlin.ru/page.aspx?1;834695 |title=Указ Президента Российской Федерации от 10 августа 2005 года № 948 |access-date=2012-01-28 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20150402092835/http://graph.document.kremlin.ru/page.aspx?1;834695 |archive-date=2015-04-02 |url-status=dead }}</ref>
* 2010 - [[Order of Friendship]]<ref>{{Cite web |url=http://graph.document.kremlin.ru/page.aspx?1;1524521 |title=Указ Президента Российской Федерации от 29 октября 2010 года № 1303 |access-date=2012-01-28 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20150402195430/http://graph.document.kremlin.ru/page.aspx?1;1524521 |archive-date=2015-04-02 |url-status=dead }}</ref>
* 2017 - Grand Cross of the [[Order of the Lion of Finland]]<ref>{{Cite web |title=Vuonna 2017 ulkomaalaisille annetut kunniamerkit – Utmärkelsetecken förlänade åt utlänningar 2017 |publisher=Ritarikunnat - Suomen Valkoisen Ruusun ja Suomen Leijonan ritarikunnat |access-date=7 September 2022 |url= https://ritarikunnat.fi/ritarikunnat/annetut-kunniamerkit/vuonna-2017-annetut-kunniamerkit-forlanade-utmarkelsetecken-2017/vuonna-2017-ulkomaalaisille-annetut-kunniamerkit-utmarkelsetecken-forlanade-at-utlanningar-2017/ |language=fi, sv }}</ref>
